items.name: v0.4.1
items.body:
## Overview

llama.cpp 0.4.1 adds Maple 20B-A1B, Tencent Hy 4, and Spark2.5 support, improves JSON schema handling, chat parsing, logging, and server child-process management, and updates ggml to v0.24.0.

### API changes

- Changed `llama_sampler_chain_n()` to return `int32_t` instead of `int` ([#28631](https://github.com/ggml-org/llama.cpp/pull/28631)).
- Added `server_subproc` and `waiter` for router child-process monitoring in `server-common.h` ([#28555](https://github.com/ggml-org/llama.cpp/pull/28555)).

### New models

- Added Maple 20B-A1B ternary MoE architecture (CPU) ([#27000](https://github.com/ggml-org/llama.cpp/pull/27000)).
- Added Tencent Hy 4 (`hy_v4`) preview architecture support ([#28127](https://github.com/ggml-org/llama.cpp/pull/28127)).
- Added Spark2.5 support ([#27868](https://github.com/ggml-org/llama.cpp/pull/27868)).

### Core changes

- Added Kimi-K3 recurrent-state rollback support ([#28466](https://github.com/ggml-org/llama.cpp/pull/28466)).
- Fixed MTP context KV cache allocation for DeepSeek2, GLM-MoE, and related models ([#28630](https://github.com/ggml-org/llama.cpp/pull/28630)).
- Fixed GDN normalization from `max` to `rsqrt` for affected Qwen/Kimi/GLM models ([#28068](https://github.com/ggml-org/llama.cpp/pull/28068)).
- Fixed Granite parameter counts and Granite3 MoE unknown parameter counts ([#28643](https://github.com/ggml-org/llama.cpp/pull/28643), [#28632](https://github.com/ggml-org/llama.cpp/pull/28632)).
- Fixed MIMO2 SWA pattern loading and incorrect `get_key_or_arr` uses ([#28865](https://github.com/ggml-org/llama.cpp/pull/28865), [#28868](https://github.com/ggml-org/llama.cpp/pull/28868)).
- Added `--fuse-qkv` conversion flag to fuse Q/K/V tensors during HF-to-GGUF conversion ([#22780](https://github.com/ggml-org/llama.cpp/
